name: Mercury MCP
description: Gives agents read-only access to Mercury business banking over a hosted OAuth MCP server in beta, covering balances, transactions, cards, statements, and invoices.

skills.name: Spend Analysis
skills.description: Lists transactions with filters for date range, status, and category, paginating automatically for complete results.

skills.name: Balances And Statements
skills.description: Retrieves account and treasury balances, plus monthly account or treasury statements for a chosen date range.

skills.name: Cards And Recipients
skills.description: Lists debit and credit cards and payment recipients, and returns details for a specific card or recipient by ID.

skills.name: Invoices And Customers
skills.description: Lists customers and invoices, returns an invoice's details and attachments, and checks the status of sent invoices.
